context.purpose: Recognize the text of one local scanned-page PNG as a machine draft: checked text, word boxes in source pixels with the recogniser's uncalibrated confidence, and an inspectable summary that binds the exact image, model and runtime. It reads pixels only; it does not read a PDF's embedded text, certify what the page says or identify the page.
context.assumptions: One opaque 8-bit RGB non-interlaced PNG without alpha; one local English LSTM traineddata pinned by SHA-256; an explicit page segmentation (uniform-block for a text block, single-line for exactly one line); Tesseract 5.5.3 on POSIX; a person reviews the draft against the image.
context.constraints: PNG <=16MiB, <=4096 px per side and 4,194,304 pixels; model <=64MiB, language eng only; <=5000 words and 100,000 word characters; TSV <=4MiB, text <=1MiB; dpi 70-2400 only as an explicit override; serial CPU, no authored native flags, global tessdata, configuration files, other languages, handwriting, multipage input or layout analysis. Optional origin binds a declared MuPDF review-summary page to the pixels by width, height and RGB SHA-256.
context.inspection: Inspect page.txt (machine draft), words.json (index, block/paragraph/line/word, left/top/width/height box in source pixels, confidence 0-100) and ocr-summary.json (image/model/runtime/settings bindings, counts, confidence range, origin state, review statement). Offline verify re-reads the retained image, model copy, native TSV/text and launchers without launching Tesseract.
context.recovery: INVALID_IMAGE_SOURCE/INVALID_MODEL: select an absolute local regular file. UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE: re-export as opaque non-interlaced RGB8 (alpha is refused, never flattened). IMAGE_RESOURCE_LIMIT: shrink the image. MODEL_HASH_MISMATCH/IMAGE_HASH_MISMATCH: the file differs from its pin. MODEL_UNUSABLE: supply an English LSTM traineddata for this runtime. OCR_NO_TEXT: no words were found; check pageSegmentation (a mismatched choice can return no words, observed on the qualification fixture, or wrong text) or the image. OCR_OUTPUT_INVALID: native files violate the strict TSV/text contract. ORIGIN_MISMATCH: the declared summary page does not describe these pixels. UNSUPPORTED_NATIVE_VERSION needs Tesseract 5.5.3; INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND needs an absolute executable.

workflow.scope: Verified image artifacts (a MuPDF page PNG or another producer's opaque RGB PNG) are consumed by workflow jobs; image/model/origin digests invalidate reuse. The real handoff run here used gnuplot as the producer; a MuPDF 1.28.5 handoff is unqualified unless run by the qualifier with that runtime.

composition.scope: Shared expressions and finite visits resolve before OCR planning.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers capture, model copy and hashing, version, loader trace, recognition and verification; CPU 600 s, address space 8GiB, file 16MiB per native process.
lifecycle.cancellation: Cancellation and deadline are checked before capture, during model streaming, after native stages and before publication; the shared owned process-tree runner terminates owned native jobs. Incomplete and failed evidence remains inspectable.
lifecycle.logs: Authored and effective plans, captured image and model copy with identities, trusted launchers, input bindings, submissions, stdout/stderr, runtime file hashes, native TSV and text, and three publications are retained; failed attempts keep their result.json fault.
lifecycle.verification: Offline: strict independent TSV reader (header, page record equals image size, consecutive hierarchy, containment, confidence text), text/TSV agreement under a stated reading-order policy, byte comparison of every publication with a rebuild from that evidence, image/model/runtime/launcher bindings, exact memberships. Never launches Tesseract; a second native run shows readback determinism only and is not independent OCR truth.

losses: Opaque RGB8 only: alpha, palette, grey, 16-bit and interlaced PNGs are refused, never flattened; colour profiles are ignored.
data.scope: One captured local page raster; pixel identity only, no page identity unless a declared origin matches.

losses: Pinned by SHA-256 and captured per run; no download, no other language, no global tessdata.
Only the declared page entry's width, height and RGB-pixel SHA-256 are checked against the image; the MuPDF run is not re-verified.
data.scope: Optional declared origin of the page image.

losses: One local opaque 8-bit RGB PNG page, non-interlaced and without alpha or tRNS, at most 16MiB, 4096 pixels per side and 4,194,304 pixels; no alpha, palette, grey, 16-bit, interlaced, animated, TIFF/JPEG, multipage, PDF or remote input. Colour profiles and gamma are ignored by the recogniser and not applied.

One explicit English fast-or-best LSTM model supplied as a local regular file pinned by SHA-256 (at most 64MiB, engine mode 1). It is captured into the run and hashed before and after the native run; the SHA-256 pin identifies the bytes, and nothing verifies that the model is actually English; global traineddata, TESSDATA_PREFIX, configuration files and authored native flags are never used.

Explicit page segmentation only (uniform-block is --psm 6, single-line is --psm 7). A wrong choice for the layout can yield fewer words, no text or wrong text; no automatic layout analysis, orientation detection, columns, tables, handwriting or non-English scripts are offered.

Native CPU, one thread, fixed output configuration (text and TSV), no dictionary or user words, no whitelist, no hOCR/ALTO/PDF output. Output is Tesseract 5.5.3 observed behaviour on the recorded pixels only.

Coordinates are whole pixels with a top-left origin in the source image: the page record must equal the image size and every box must lie inside it; right and bottom edges are exclusive. Boxes are the recogniser's own and are not independently segmented.

Confidence is native decimal text from 0 to 100, uncalibrated. Text is the TSV words in native record order, joined by single spaces and newlines; recognition accuracy, spelling, reading order for complex layouts and content truth are not certified.

The result identifies pixels, not a page. Origin is retained only when a MuPDF review summary is declared and its page entry matches the image width, height and RGB-pixel SHA-256; the MuPDF run itself is not re-verified here and an image without an origin has no page, document or capture identity.
data.scope: TSV words joined in native record order; paragraph separators and trailing whitespace are not preserved.

losses: Boxes are the recogniser's own, not independently segmented; confidence is not accuracy.
data.scope: Per-word block/paragraph/line/word indices, box and confidence.

losses: Bindings and counts only; no truth, review or identity claim.
data.scope: Image/model/runtime/settings bindings, counts, origin state and review statement.

inspection.scope: Read the machine-draft page text, word boxes and summary.
inspection.limits: Draft review only; no overlay, no editing, no accuracy claim.

authoring.reuse: Edit the image or model path and pin, pageSegmentation, optional dpi or origin; plan fresh and verify. Same-path byte changes invalidate workflow reuse.

workflow.scope: Image artifacts from verified producers are consumed through normal workflow jobs; OCR publications are text artifacts. Pandoc OCR-block ingestion is not offered.

composition.scope: Shared expressions and finite visits resolve before planning.

reusable-inputs.scope: Captured image, model and optional origin-summary bytes participate in reuse identity.

source-authoring.scope: Shared JSON editing, undo and validation support the closed document.

property-authoring.scope: Shared forms expose image, model, origin, language, segmentation and dpi.

native-inspection.scope: No interactive native-inspection hook; the summary is a publication.

time-batches.scope: A page is one explicit image, not a temporal dataset.

native-save.scope: The captured image is retained; no edited image is saved.

conversion.scope: Only recognition of one page; no format conversion.

cases.scope: Synthetic 483x228 opaque RGB page drawn with DejaVu Sans Bold (committed fixture): the literal words and their ink positions (measured from the PNG pixels by tools/qualify_tesseract_fixtures.py, first-line and RIVER left edges within 1 px) are known independently of OCR. Scope is this fixture, the pinned eng fast model and Tesseract 5.5.3 only; accuracy is not certified. Baseline.

Synthetic 483x228 opaque RGB page drawn with DejaVu Sans Bold (committed fixture): the literal words and their ink positions (measured from the PNG pixels by tools/qualify_tesseract_fixtures.py, first-line and RIVER left edges within 1 px) are known independently of OCR. Scope is this fixture, the pinned eng fast model and Tesseract 5.5.3 only; accuracy is not certified. One changed word pair (1357 to 2468) must change the text.
